items.title: One sentence across four particles
items.caption: Only the first word changes. The two pasts differ in the shape of the event, rather than how long ago it happened; the other particles report a change or future time.

states.label: *sā*
states.note: This past presents how things were over a stretch of time.

states.label: *na*
states.note: This past presents a single, bounded, finished, or unexpected event.

states.label: *ʻua*
states.note: It reports a change and usually leaves a new state in place.

states.label: *ʻoleʻā*
states.note: It places the event ahead of now.

items.title: Past state and present change
items.caption: The past particle closes off the earlier state. The change particle reports what holds after the change.

items.title: Type the state words
items.intro: Read the meaning and type the Samoan word.
